nora: quick FYI — planning a short change window tonight 01:30 UTC to flip a runtime flag and restart a small set of dedicated pools. Low risk but want customer-facing copy and pin instructions. who can draft?
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-11-20T01:30:00Z; canary=10m; rollout=50m; auto-rollback=error_rate>6%_over_5m; notify-channel=#eng-platform.
mike_ops: i'll take pins and runbook. will produce a list of customers to 'pin-to-stable' (p50 < 110ms) and hand it to support by 17:30 UTC.
jen_support: i'll draft the customer-facing artifacts. Posting short drafts for review:

STATUSPAGE (one-liner): "Maintenance: brief rolling runtime update on Dedicated inference pools in select regions. You may see short request interruptions while pools restart. Live updates will be posted on our status page. Window: 01:30 UTC ".

EMAIL (impacted customers): "Subject: Notice: Redwood runtime update tonight (01:30 UTC)

Hello,

We're performing a brief runtime configuration update and rolling restarts of a small subset of dedicated inference pools tonight at 01:30 UTC. Impact: some requests may see short interruptions or retries while pools restart.

If your account is on our critical SLA list we will pin your workloads to the prior runtime snapshot for the duration (we call this a `snapshot-lock`). We will monitor metrics continuously and automatically rollback if error signals cross safety thresholds. We will send live updates via the status page and notify directly if we pause or rollback.

No action required unless this conflicts with a maintenance freeze on your side; reply to this email to coordinate.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations"

mike_ops: ops FAQ snippet: - expected: brief 502/503s or retries; most traffic will route to warm pools. - pinning: auto-pin list applied 15m before start. - rollback/hold: canary hold if quality/error thresholds hit; auto-rollback on sustained error >6% over 5m. - post-checks: export token-cost delta + 5-sample quality diff for product.

mike_ops: PIN COMMAND (internal example):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"cust-424","route":"/v1/chat","model":"rwd-13b-q","version":"2026-10-18"}'
```
sam_product: add a reassurance line: "If we detect generation-quality regressions we will pause the rollout and notify affected customers immediately." put that in email and ops FAQ.
jen_support: added. I'll schedule statuspage publish 30m before window and queue the email at T+7 into canary. i'll include localized time conversions and support alias.
nora: perfect. mike — send the auto-pin list to jen by 17:30 UTC. after rollout export token-level cost delta and a quick quality diff for #product-qa. keep edits to this thread; deploy-bot should post schedule updates here automatically. :white_check_mark:
jen_support: queued templates to #ops-docs and scheduled hooks. will post final links here when ready.
